calls.statement:
SELECT 
  vat_rate,
  SUM(gross_amount - net_amount) AS vat_charged,
  COUNT(*) AS line_count,
  SUM(net_amount) AS net_sales,
  SUM(gross_amount) AS gross_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-26' AND '2024-09-22'
  AND s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY vat_rate
ORDER BY vat_rate

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  f.sale_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.vat_class) as distinct_vat_classes,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.vat_rate) as distinct_rates
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-26' AND '2024-09-22'
  AND s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY f.sale_date
ORDER BY f.sale_date

SELECT 
  f.sale_date,
  p.vat_class,
  f.vat_rate,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  SUM(gross_amount - net_amount) as vat_charged
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-26' AND '2024-09-22'
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND p.vat_class = 'standard'
GROUP BY f.sale_date, p.vat_class, f.vat_rate
ORDER BY f.sale_date, f.vat_rate

SELECT 
  f.vat_rate,
  ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount), 2) AS vat_charged,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
  COUNT(*) AS line_count,
  MIN(f.sale_date) AS first_sale_date,
  MAX(f.sale_date) AS last_sale_date
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-26' AND '2024-09-22'
  AND s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY f.vat_rate
ORDER BY f.vat_rate

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_lines,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN vat_rate IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_vat_rates,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN gross_amount IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_gross,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN net_amount IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_net,
  COUNT(DISTINCT vat_rate) as distinct_rates
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-26' AND '2024-09-22'
  AND s.store_id < 900

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  vat_rate,
  ROUND(AVG(ABS((gross_amount - net_amount) - (net_amount * vat_rate))), 6) as avg_variance,
  MAX(ABS((gross_amount - net_amount) - (net_amount * vat_rate))) as max_variance,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN ABS((gross_amount - net_amount) - (net_amount * vat_rate)) > 0.01 THEN 1 END) as rows_with_variance
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-26' AND '2024-09-22'
  AND s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY vat_rate
ORDER BY vat_rate

  f.vat_rate,
  ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount), 2) AS vat_charged_eur

GROUP BY f.vat_rate
